title: BiasRV: Uncovering Biased Sentiment Predictions at Runtime
benchmark_measurement: Bias against atheists in sentiment prediction, cited from a previous study as a motivating example for the proposed tool.
findings: The paper cites a finding from a previous study (Ribeiro et al., 2020) that a sentiment analysis system fine-tuned on BERT predicted negative sentiment for text templates filled with the word 'atheist', demonstrating a form of religious bias. The paper's own experiments did not focus on religion but used this as a motivating example.
